steps.text: Uptown Lungmen 7:00 P.M., Dusk

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: A secret arrest warrant? For Ch'en Sir?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: It's gotta be a mistake? There's no way...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Hey! Get back here! I asked you if this was a mistake or not!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Damn it, Ch'en Sir, what the hell... who's behind this?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I have to find her. I have to hear her side of the story!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Yes. I understand.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Anything else, Master?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No. Go and do what I told you for now. When you're finished, find somewhere to lay low for a while.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now go. Hurry.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ——*Sigh*. It turns out there really is someone who can outplay Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Talulah, Talulah... is this really just fate?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh, Young Master, if you could see us now from up there, you also would not wish to see this, would you?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But alas, Lungmen's finally come to this.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But Hui-chieh... Hui-chieh! Be careful, Hui-chieh... You mustn't get yourself killed!
Lungmen Harbor Dock 7:20 P.M.

steps.name: Herd
steps.text: Guh... agh! Nng... grrgh...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Damnit, there's still so many of them out there... I thought the L.G.D. was supposed to have this area under control?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yesterday it was Reunion, today it's these weird Infected. Even we can't hold them off. And we can't use heavy-duty weapons inside the city...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hello, Operators. Is that who we're fighting today?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Rosmontis! Thank goodness, we're saved.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They're Infected who have been twisted by Arts...? And we can't stop them?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That's right. We mostly brought defense equipment, but I never expected that they'd shred through our steel cables and polyfiber nets like paper. We might have to bring in some military-grade weapons.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We're at our limits here, so we had no choice but to ask for backup from the landship. Thankfully, now that you're here, we might be able to turn the tides.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The Originium structure inside makes their bodies incredibly tough. We use suppressing fire to keep them under control. Also... our scans aren't picking up any signs of brain activity at all.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The main point there is, they're pretty much... already physically dead. They're just empty husks, propped up by Arts. It's unbelievably cruel...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Whoever did this... has to pay.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But more importantly, at least you all are safe.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Let's make a plan. I'll... get them to settle down.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Doctor... have you never met Rosmontis before?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Please stand aside, Doctor.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Then, you might want to take a step back. I guarantee you've never seen anything like this.

options: Is that a metal box from the landship flying by?!
That thing floating in the air there, is your equipment?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's mine.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Operator, please describe your impressions of the target.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hold on, I'll check the manual... Okay, the target's, uh, a large group of active, restless individuals?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They're moving as a group with no clear objective. Their general trend is clear, but with no set route. That should be good enough, right?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Received. I'll handle this.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit was very clear, once we finish with this, Rhodes Island is to leave Lungmen immediately...!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Evening, old friend.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma...? What are you doing here? How about your injuries?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm an Oni. Those scratches are long gone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good. Now, I—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hold on. Were you waiting for me here?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That dune buggy you're pushing is a new model from Rim Billiton, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: 'Great for off-road performance. Dustproof, climbs hills with ease, incredible range and fuel efficiency. Minimal environmental impact with maximum comfort.' That one?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, sorry. I saw that ad on the terminal a million times. Guess it got stuck in the old noggin.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's a damn good buggy though. I'm not even into off-roading and I'd like to get one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you trying to say?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You look like hell, Ch'en. Where do you plan on going?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How did you know I'd be here...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You come here every time you want to sneak out of the city. Remember, I also know every nook and cranny of this place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The L.G.D. issued an arrest warrant.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But that's not what you're here for.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Of course not. I know exactly what kind of person you are.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is my only way out of Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I stayed dark the whole way. If the whole L.G.D. knew me half as well as you do...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Then you'll never make it out of Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Excuse me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean by that?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're just like me. They don't want you to go.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma... are you going to stop me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why you, of all people, Hoshiguma?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Of course I am, Ch'en. I'm an L.G.D. inspector, and more importantly, your friend.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did you seriously plan to wander off and play the lone hero on a grand adventure? That is precisely why I cannot let you leave.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're a Lungmenite, Hoshiguma!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is our last chance. If Wei Yenwu has it his way, more people are going to die!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And your way is better?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They call you 'Madame Oni.' They trust you to take care of the Lungmen they love so much. Let me go, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do they really love Lungmen, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Me? I'm old school.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Comics, movies, booze, rainy streets, some guy running by without an umbrella. I like my stuff retro, just not bikes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: People say some stuff goes out of style quick. Ch'en, can we really outrun time itself?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I can't. No way. It moves too fast. That chase has crushed so much of what I cared about.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is all I have left. A yellowed splotch, a tear, a dog-eared page. I've got names for 'em all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And it sucks. I hate how time took all these people from me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They died horrible, miserable deaths, sacrificing themselves to try to find a place in this world. But me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I simply watched them all vanish into dust. Some of them? I smashed their dreams to pieces with these very two hands.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They didn't love Lungmen. They simply had nowhere else to go. And in the end, that was my fault.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're not going anywhere, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah Faat died, all those people died for Lungmen... You're going to pretend you never saw any of that?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't act like you knew them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They were with me a lot longer than you. I knew them much better than you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's my duty to protect Lungmen. No matter who stands in my way, it's my duty. That hasn't changed.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you're still Superintendent Ch'en? And who gave you this duty?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Is that just something you wanted to hear yourself say?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Look at you. You're gonna save Lungmen all by yourself? One woman against all of Reunion? Your temper tantrum won't get you that far.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's funny. You're the one who always carried out Mr. Wei's orders, because you could relate with him. Now I'm the one who relates with him a bit better, and I'm the one carrying out his orders. How the tables have turned.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I've seen the gist of Mr. Wei's plans. If someone has to die, Mr. Wei thinks it ought to be him. You're carrying the Ch'en family's blood. Once all this blows over, no one's coming after you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You mean, he—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mr. Wei would rather he die than you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You give him too much credit.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Maybe you don't give him enough, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If he wants to die, he's welcome to it. But what will that get us? What's the point? Will it prevent a war? Will it get Lungmen out of this mess?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If he dies, it'll get some of the blame off Lungmen. I think all the blame will pretty much vanish into thin air, actually.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You really think it'll be that easy?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Nothing's ever that easy. That's why he wants you running the L.G.D.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You'll get his job and be Chief of the L.G.D. sooner or later. After that, you'll become the boss of the entire city.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's been a lot of rot left behind, and you should be the one to clean it out.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I get what Mr. Wei wants from you. Though he's been waiting for a long time, I can tell that his beliefs and methods haven't changed from the day I met him.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Lungmen still needs you. And she doesn't want you in danger.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm just so disgusted.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mr. Wei's death may not matter to you. But once he's gone, you can change this city.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have to tell you something, Hoshiguma. It's the reason I don't belong here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't mess with me, Ch'en. No one's more Lungmen than you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm an Infected.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Since when...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Three years ago.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You've been hiding it from me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I didn't mean to...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How come you didn't even tell me...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wei Yenwu didn't want anyone to know. We couldn't have an Infected in the L.G.D. So I couldn't be Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, there is no place for the Infected here. Or anywhere else in the world.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've had enough of Wei Yenwu controlling us. I'm not going to be his tool anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No. I get it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I finally... actually, really get it, Ch'en. I know exactly why you can't leave Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If you leave and go to that core city, Mr. Wei would have to brand you an enemy. Not just an enemy, but a dangerous Infected enemy working against Lungmen...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The whole city would know you're Infected. They might even think you're working with Reunion.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And that'll be the end of it. You'll never be able to come back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's my line.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: 'You're Infected? I don't care.'

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't care. Missy doesn't care. Nine doesn't care. The L.G.D. doesn't care.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not even Mr. Wei cares. He wants you to change this place. He doesn't want you gone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You didn't see how ruthlessly he treated the Infected. I did.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And Nine? She's already gone. She quit the L.G.D. because she was Infected too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Nine too...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You know, Nine and I might've contracted Oripathy on the same mission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She went undercover for me in Reunion... And then, because of Reunion, she abandoned Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Because she saw the truth of this city.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But you didn't betray Lungmen. I'm not letting you take the fall for a crime you didn't commit.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, why do you think... I'm going to the core city?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I've never been good at guessing games. Just get to the point.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Heh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you know who's leading Reunion?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I forgot her name.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Missy didn't tell you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Tell me what?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah is my sister.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh. Ohhh... Hah. I get it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, you're not going today.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Why...? Is my sister, my family... not important enough?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's why...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's why I can't let you go.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Even if I have to die here. I'm not letting you go.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not for you to decide, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hannya can decide.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: —No matter what stands in my way, whether it's a Catastrophe, a shield, or an Oni, I'm not giving in!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The blacksmith who cast this shield had his whole family killed by a gang of wandering Onis. His fury is much more toxic than any Catastrophe.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The blood that stains this shield, and the tragedy it represents... is much more wicked than any Catastrophe.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, Mr. Wei isn't a good man. We can kick his ass together.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Whatever you want to do, I'll do it with you. You want my Columbian Big Single 70 vv? It's yours.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, now's not the time. Don't go. Don't force me to do this. It's all I ask.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Force you? Why are you talking like Wei Yenwu...? I don't like it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When Wei did what he did... no.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When he betrayed his brother, failed my mother, and put this city to sleep under his cloud of wickedness, that's when I decided to do this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You might think that stuff has anything to do with you, but I don't think so.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What he did, what he did for you, and what you should be doing, none of it is connected.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's what Mr. Wei was hoping for. He didn't want to play the bad guy. He's not power-hungry...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He gave you the sword.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...You don't get it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Understand what?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It wasn't just one time. It happened again, and again, and again... I destroyed my home, I destroyed my family.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Covered horn to toe in blood every time, I fought to the bitter end, until I was the only one left standing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Because that's what I thought was right. And they were wrong.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I found myself asking a lot if I really deserved to live.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't. But I lived anyway. I just can't live for myself anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Putting yourself out because of some concept of right and wrong... that's the dumbest thing a person can do.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And I've dealt with the regret my whole life.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You think you're the only one who's got a lot of baggage, Miss Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop talking like that!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...So why can't you understand me, even a little bit?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We've been through so much together, all these years. There's still something you can't tell me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've got my baggage and you've got yours. We both know that. Even so...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What is there you still don't understand? I never pulled any of you into this! How can you say I don't understand you?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Because I've seen too many people die for nothing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't care who you are. I just care where you're going.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not letting you go. This is all on the leader of Reunion. You can't change the situation. You'll just die for nothing too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No one wants to see that. Not the L.G.D., not Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: —Thank you, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I'm still going.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If we have to fight, you should know I'm not scared of you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You really have to go, huh? You feeling like your heart is hard as iron right now?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I told you before, you're lost in your own thoughts, you lost sight of everything around you, of everything everyone's done for you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Your stubbornness is only gonna get you hurt.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine. I guess you'll have to take a beating before you can learn, like a young Hoshiguma, that being a stubborn ass is just a stupid impulse.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If you want to fight, Ch'en... Then let's do it. Show me everything you've learned in the last two years.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop. Talking. Like. That.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: EX-42 Long-Range Originium Arts Control Device, Operator Rosmontis, requesting approval.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Approved for use in defensive operations. Removal approved.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: User: Annihilation Specialist, Elite Operator Rosmontis. Activation approved.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Okay. I'm going.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Please tell Closure for me, about the Rhodes Island landship startup.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hurry, Doctor, get in the cabin. Don't watch.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If you get hit by Rosmontis's shrapnel, you're pretty much a goner.
